Stale secretary signal cannot influence gear; any conflict with fresher formal authority invalidates secretary influence.
Anti-thrash may suppress only nonessential upshift and must never delay risk/recovery downshift; current v2.1 branch applies the hold only when selected gear is above current gear.
Heartbeat/window age/poll/retry/reconnect/wait/scheduler wake are zero Experience; P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance and formal authority remain unchanged.

Exact-current same-runner regression now exists for the current six Gearbox source/test blobs: v1=21 PASS, v2=16 PASS, v2.1=12 PASS, total=49 PASS. This is candidate execution evidence only and does not clear review vetoes or replace C verification.
TEST_REQUIRED: Anti-thrash threshold/sample/window/cooldown and bounded safe-upshift recovery require clean baseline plus incident replay and false-positive/missed-warning accounting.
Pressure/gear probability bands remain engineering heuristics until clean baseline plus incident replay records false-positive and missed-warning statistics; they are not calibrated probabilities.

Speedup requires paired matched-workload metrics only: durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency, with verification/risk non-regression. Window age, commits, wake count and task last_run are forbidden speed evidence.

Predictive Navigator requires strict TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN input semantics plus provenance/freshness and clean-baseline/incident replay validation before predictive output can influence Gearbox adoption.
BOUNDED_VETO: Secretary freshness/conflict are caller-supplied booleans with no replay-resistant freshness envelope or exact authority-snapshot binding; non-bool values such as string 'false' are truthy and unsafe.
Verified Experience accepts truthiness-coerced verification flags and lacks exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier receipt, mission/step, installation/workspace and revocation binding.

Experience dedupe is event_id-only and aggregate_experience_events recreates its seen set on every invocation; same durable evidence can inflate credit under new IDs or across calls, polling, restart or rollback.
Event identity is not immutably sealed to event kind, canonical evidence hash, verifier receipt and source/install/workspace lineage; same-ID semantic rebinding can create additional verified credit.

select_gear_v2_1 independently recomputes verified_experience_delta from caller event_kind plus bool(event_independently_verified), bypassing any future durable ledger/dedupe repair. Adoptable decisions must consume a trusted AcceptedExperienceReceipt/ledger result or emit zero verified credit.

Adoptable Experience exactly-once needs one durable replay-resistant acceptance authority keyed by canonical evidence_hash plus provenance/source lineage plus trusted verifier receipt identity, with monotonic rollback/restart protection.

recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-controlled; adoptable anti-thrash must derive it from a canonical append-only shift ledger plus versioned observation-window policy and ignore or reject caller ratio.

Predictive Navigator _flag uses bool(value), so string 'false' becomes true; missing continuity fields collapse to false instead of UNKNOWN. This can create false escalation or false recovery-anchor failure.
